title: Onboard load and buddy capacity review - Nov 10 2025
content:
Meeting: Onboarding buddy load & capacity review
Date: 2025-11-10
Facilitator: Marco Nguyen
Attendees: Aisha Patel, Lina Rodriguez, David Chen, Priya Menon, Marco Nguyen
Purpose: quick sync to surface buddy load pressure from the last two hiring waves, align on near-term adjustments, and capture actions for next sprint.

Summary / TL;DR:
- Recent new-hire cohort (6 ICs started between 10/27 and 11/03) exposed buddy capacity constraints: several buddies (primarily infra and serving-runtime) are handling 3+ active mentees plus full-time project work.
- Observed recurring ramp blockers: env setup delays, missing runbook steps, lack of lightweight first-week tasks for some streams.
- Agreed short-term fixes: limit new buddy assignments to max 2 concurrent mentees where possible, create a rotating "buddy overflow" pool (2 engineers, 0.2 FTE each), and publish a condensed first-week checklist with concrete pairing tasks.
- Longer-term: proposal to bump headcount in dev-ex or formally fund 0.5 FTE of each subteam for onboarding support for the next 6 months; put a small hiring ask to PLs during capacity planning (ENG-3492).

Notes / Discussion:
1) Buddy load picture (Aisha)
   - Concrete numbers: 12 active mentee relationships in last 6 weeks; median buddy load = 2, mean = 2.7; 3 buddies at load 4+.
   - Pain points called out: context switching cost for buddies on serving-runtime (high cognitive load), and infra buddies getting pulled to urgent incidents which pushes onboarding tasks out.

2) Ramp blockers observed (Lina)
   - Two common blockers: local GPU environment failures (50% of infra tickets for new hires) and lack of a small, end-to-end sandbox exercise for infra/serving that completes within day 3.
   - New hires report unclear expectations for "first deliverable" in some teams.

3) Quick fixes proposed and debated
   - Short checklist: add step-by-step GPU env repro script + contact points; link snippet in new hire welcome email. Owner: David. Target: 2025-11-14.
   - "Buddy overflow" rota: two volunteers (Priya + David) to cover overflow office hours 3x/week for first 6 weeks of each cohort. Scope: triage setup, pair on quick tasks, escalate to team buddy for deeper codewalks. Owner: Priya. Target: publish rota by 2025-11-12.
   - Limit new buddy assignments to 2 active mentees by default. Exceptions require PL sign-off. Owner: Marco. Effective: immediate.

4) Interview/debrief implications (David)
   - Candidate pool remains strong for junior roles but some mismatch on expected ramp speed (candidates expecting slower pace). We should add a short note in job descriptions about "fast-paced onboarding with pairing expectations". Owner: Recruiter sync (Aisha).

5) Onboarding content improvements (Lina + Marco)
   - Create a 1-week "starter project" per team: 5–8 hour scoped tasks that are useful to product/infra and can be completed with pairing. Each team's PM/tech lead to propose one by 11/21.
   - Convert existing long-run runbooks into a 2-page "first-48-hours" doc for each subteam. Template created. Owner: Lina. Target draft: 2025-11-18.

6) Metrics to track (agreed)
   - Time to first PR merged (target median <= 10 days)
   - Number of buddy interruptions per week (reduce by 30% in 8 weeks)
   - New hire sentiment pulse (1-week and 4-week surveys)
   - Chart ownership: eng-ops will add fields to hiring dashboard (ENG-3492). Owner: Aisha.

Action items (owner — due)
- David: Draft the GPU environment repro script and update welcome email snippet — 2025-11-14
- Priya: Publish buddy overflow rota and office hours schedule — 2025-11-12
- Marco: Update buddy assignment default policy & notify PLs — 2025-11-11
- Lina: Template + first-48-hours doc drafts for each subteam — 2025-11-18
- Aisha: Add "onboarding pace" blurb to job descriptions and sync with recruiting — 2025-11-17
- PLs (all): Propose 1-week starter project for your team — 2025-11-21
- Eng-ops: Add new metrics to hiring dashboard (ENG-3492) — 2025-11-20

Open questions / follow-ups
- Should we temporarily reduce hiring velocity for infra/serving-runtime until buddy capacity is increased? (deferred; PLs to self-assess)
- How to measure buddy time precisely (timeboxed calendar blocks vs retrospective logs)? Next sync to experiment with a simple calendar label. Owner: Marco.

Quick retrospective (what worked / what didn't for this cohort)
- Worked: cohort onboarding kickoff session was well received; developers liked the "who to ping" cheat sheet.
- Didn't work: too many ad-hoc troubleshooting requests routed to buddies instead of the new-hire Slack channel; need clearer triage rules.

Notes to self (informal)
- Consider rotating one senior engineer through the onboarding rota each quarter as a paid "onboarding sabbatical" (0.1 FTE) — test on infra team next quarter.
- Keep this doc lightweight; move full proposals to Confluence if we escalate to a headcount ask.

Attachments / referenced tickets:
- ENG-3492 (hiring dashboard + metric fields)
- Confluence: Onboarding Playbook (link above)
- Slack thread: #eng-onboarding, thread p2Z8H4k (reports from new hires)

Next meeting: quick follow-up 2025-11-17, 30 minutes to review progress on short fixes and rota.

End of notes.
